articles.title: Buzzi (BIT:BZU) Looks Undervalued On Paper, Is The Pullback A Bargain?
articles.summary: Recent trading in Buzzi (BIT:BZU) has drawn attention after a period of mixed share performance, with the stock down over the past week, month and past three months, despite a positive three-year and five-year total return record. Buzzi’s recent 30-day share price return, down about 6%, and a year to date share price decline of roughly 27% point to fading short term momentum.
